environment: candidate checkout and the assembled pinned xverse-platform target; offline, Python 3.11+; no ambient clock read and no implicit unit assumption.
expected: Declared time domains and mappings are recorded without inference, and unknown units, imprecise ticks and non-finite, negative or overflow quantities are rejected with the frozen stable code and no plan; no conversion is invented and no scientific protocol number is defaulted or narrowed.
intended_use: An experiment author declares time domains, a time mapping with tolerance and schedule/duration quantities and expects only explicit units to be interpreted.
title: Explicit time domain and quantity/unit validation without inference
